idona_power_dump.text: consume your whole mana bar. Your max mana sets the largest bonus,
, and each cast multiplies its damage by
1 + that bonus x the share of your bar it spent above its cost
. Each cast keeps its own bonus for its own hits; damage over time is not boosted. Casts made standing up and toggles are unaffected.

Held channels cast while sneaking drain 50% of your bar per second; each tick counts only its own drain above its cost. Every Implode gets the bonus for the mana it consumes, sneaking or not, and so does a Starforge nova that procs while you sneak.

Examples, ignoring the spell's own cost: a cast from a full bar gets x4.5 at 1,000 max mana, x17 at 20,000 and x44 at 150,000. From a half-full bar: x2.8, x8.9, x23. A held channel's ticks get x1.09, x1.4, x2.1.
